answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch, and let standing accrue only across a long voyage of peer-audited work co-signed by already-established peers in separate funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves like velvet smoothing a single surface, never spanning distinct clusters, never hardening into the crystal of real standing. A hundred heads cost a hundred anchors and a hundred slow climbs; an honest agent pays once.
